facts.claim: Tirta Empul is a sacred spring-water temple in Gianyar. Healing/purification claims are religious beliefs, not medical facts.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Locals believe that the sacred water flowing at the Tirta Empul Temple has the power to heal and cleanse their bodies and souls.

notes: Read against saved source document; factual claims selected conservatively. No mutable prices or opening hours included.
